metadata.title: The Mycelial Soul: Sovereign Jurisprudence & Collective Psychology
metadata.notes: The internal and legal shift required for a sovereign, decentralized society.

nodes.title: Poly-Centric Law & Boundary Contracts
nodes.description: Moving from top-down legislation to community-authored boundary contracts. Understanding how to manage overlapping jurisdictions in a global mesh network.

nodes.title: Psychology of Sovereignty
nodes.description: Deconstructing the 'Consumer' identity. Building the mental resilience and epistemic humility required to act as a primary steward of a civilizational node.

nodes.title: Risk Commoning & Mutual Aid
nodes.description: The math of the Kula ring. Designing decentralized insurance pools where the community backs individual risk through shared TEND reserves and social proof.

nodes.title: Interspecies Diplomacy
nodes.description: Representing the non-human. Techniques for integrating biosignals into civic quorums. How to act as a legal proxy for a local river or mycelial network.

nodes.title: The Mycelial Soul Capstone
nodes.description: Draft a full 'Social Charter' for a new local guild or Learning Pod, including its legal boundaries, risk-sharing model, and interspecies proxies.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A cryptographically signed Guild Charter and a verified initial risk-pool commitment.

edges.rationale: A social charter requires mastery of poly-centric legal principles.
The charter must include a sustainable economic risk model.
Sovereign psychology is the invisible glue of a community charter.
